svg.title: Migration sequence
svg.desc: Assess, import BAT data, map device pools to Webex locations, cut numbers, move devices, leave a trunk for who remains.
svg.text: T8-R06 - one site at a time

g.text: Calls between a moved user and a user still on Unified CM cross the local gateway.
Size that trunk for the overlap, not for the final steady state.
Device pool becomes the hint for a Webex location. It does not become a CAC location.
Calling permissions replace the line CSS. Emergency address is per Webex location.
Dedicated Instance is a different project: the cluster moves, the objects stay.
Teams Phone is a different SBC conversation. Do not mix the cut sheets.
